# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c14 P65](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0065), [v3 c8 P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Bill  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

He is described as a large, heavy-set, overweight young man, twenty years of age (when first described), with a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P28](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0028), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)_

## Personality

He possesses an agonizing inability to hold a conversation or engage in chatter, rarely laughing, and instead usually smirks or laughs softly. Despite his shyness, he is immensely proud when accompanying a young woman he admires. He lacks vices, is an earnest and hard worker, and is considered reliable.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P28](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0028), [v1 c19 P29](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0029), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)_

## Traits

- Shy and quiet  <sub>[v1 c19 P28](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0028), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)</sub>
- Lacks conversation skills  <sub>[v1 c19 P28](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0028)</sub>
- Hardworking and reliable  <sub>[v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)</sub>

## Abilities

- Harnessing and driving horses/buggies  <sub>[v1 c14 P65](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0065), [v1 c19 P28](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0028)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry and settle down on his own farm  <sub>[v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)</sub>

## History

Barney initially drove Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke to the Sunday-school picnic using the sorrel mare. Later, he drove a double-seated buggy carrying his sister Odette, Nell, and Isolde to the concert at the Debating Club hall. He also drove Nell, Isolde, and Odette to a concert and supper at the Pale Sands Hotel, though he fled to the team out of dread of attending the social supper. When his father bestowed the upper farm on him, he sought a wife. Too shy to ask Nell Harcourt directly, he persuaded his sister Odette to propose to her on his behalf. Upon Nell's rejection of the proposal, he promptly married Nettie Scobie, and their marriage was published ("appeared out") in church shortly thereafter.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P65](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0065), [v1 c19 P36](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0036), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c29 P7](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0007)_
